case.title: Empty coupon field → total shows ₹NaN
case.summary: Empty coupon code ("") bypassed the applyCoupon() guard (empty string is falsy, so `if (code && !isKnownCoupon(code))` never threw). The empty string was silently added to couponCodes. computeTotals() then called couponDiscount(subtotal, ""), which looked up COUPON_RULES[""] → undefined → parseCouponRule(undefined) → parseFloat(undefined) → NaN, causing ₹NaN to display for both Discount and Total. Fix: added `if (!code) return cart;` as the first guard in applyCoupon(), so empty or whitespace-only input is a no-op. All 112 tests pass; repro test confirms fix. Critic approved.

plainSummary.text: When a customer applied an empty coupon code, the checkout page showed "₹NaN" as the total price instead of the correct amount. This happened because the code tried to calculate the discount using an invalid value, causing the math to produce "NaN" (Not a Number). The fix added a check to return the original cart without trying to apply the discount when no coupon code is provided, so the checkout correctly displays the actual total price again.
